author: OpenAI Codex
statement: For the fixed charge-one asymmetric predecessor codebooks, the grade-six N=4 scalar shift weights are exactly quadratic on shifts -12 through 12, and no nonzero scalar weight vanishes at -1, 0, and 1. At grade four N=2 a full-rank pairing survives that exclusion, while excluding -2 through 2 leaves only zero pairings. This is finite evidence, not an asymptotic SAT improvement. At h=9, five input pairs certify that the central-excluded scalar-weight space has rational dimension at most 8; existence remains open.
